about: Identifier vectors (ledger #4126) computed from tests/vectors/identifier_cases.json by crates/ikigai-events/tests/vectors.rs, which fails if this file differs from what it computes. Every 64-bit number is a STRING of decimal digits. Where the crate refuses, the value is null and `refusal` holds its one sentence; a face must refuse exactly there, and matching the sentence byte for byte is recommended. `tokens`: per token kind, whether each input is accepted. `names`: each IRI read as an entry, a feed and a listener. `cursors`: a cursor's text read and written back. `event_keys`: event_key(source, id), BLAKE3 over the domain, source and id, each framed by its byte length as a little-endian u64, written `event:b3:{hex}`. `fence_keys` and `fence_texts`: a fencing key built and read. `lower` and `lift`: the CloudEvents attribute mapping, each way. `mapping` and `constants`: the mapping as data.

lift.name: an ikigai layer entry from a peer
an ikigai transition from a peer
an ikigai-looking id from a foreign source
another specversion
lift.refusal: `0.3` is not a CloudEvents version these attributes follow: send `specversion` `1.0`.

lift.name: no type
lift.refusal: An event's `type` is empty: name what kind of event it is.

lift.name: no id
lift.refusal: An event's `id` is empty: name the event within its source.

lift.name: an epoch with no position
lift.refusal: An event names an `ikepoch` with no `ikseq`: send both, or neither.

lift.name: a position of zero
lift.refusal: `0` is not a sequence number: a feed's positions start at 1.

lift.name: a position as a padded number
lift.refusal: `007` is not a sequence number: use decimal digits with no sign and no leading zero, at most 18446744073709551615.

lift.name: a malformed epoch
lift.refusal: `E 1` is not a feed epoch: use 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

lower.name: a layer entry with an epoch
a transition with a subject and a trace
a transition given another position
lower.refusal: `urn:iki:ledger:default:transition:seq:9` is at position 9, not 8: give the transition its own position.

lower.name: an entry with no type
lower.refusal: An entry's type is empty: give its `rdf:type` IRI or its feed event's kind.

mapping.ikigai: the entry's IRI (`urn:layer:{layer}:entry:{id}`, `urn:iki:ledger:{ledger}:transition:seq:{n}`), unique within its source
the entry's `rdf:type` as an IRI, or the feed event's kind (`say`, `out`, `taken`, `returned`, `sweep`)
the resource the entry is about (a tuple's subject, an item's IRI), when it names one
`dcterms:created`, the host clock's stamp; taken in as AUTHORED time, never as commit order
the media type of the entry's representation (`text/turtle`, `application/ld+json`)
the entry's feed position (`ik:seq`) as decimal digits in a string; advisory when taken in, since only the receiving log assigns positions
the feed's epoch, when the feed names one
the run's W3C trace context, when it has one
